name: 收割治疗
description: 使本棋子恢复等同于本次实际伤害50%的生命。
code: function executeSkill(context) { const sourcePiece = context.piece; const damage = context.damage || 0; const healAmount = Math.floor(damage * 0.5); if (healAmount > 0 && sourcePiece.currentHp < sourcePiece.maxHp) { const healResult = healDamage(sourcePiece, sourcePiece, healAmount, context.battle, context.skill.id); return { message: sourcePiece.name + '通过收割治疗了' + healResult.heal + '点生命', success: true }; } return { message: '', success: true }; }
